name: PK InExPress
author: Fatur

sections.description:
Fast and flexible XML importer from management software, CRMs and custom XML feeds to WordPress.

PK InExPress supports two import modes:

  • Quick Import provides ready-to-use integrations for supported management systems and WordPress destinations.
  • Manual Import allows custom XML feeds from virtually any management system to be mapped and imported into supported WordPress destinations.

PK InExPress is not limited to real estate. Real estate is currently the first sector with predefined Quick Import integrations, while Manual Import is designed for compatible XML feeds from different industries and management systems.

Current Quick Import integrations include:

  • RealSoftware → Houzez
  • RealSoftware → Estatik
  • MioGest → Houzez
  • MioGest → Estatik

Extended Description

PK InExPress is a flexible XML importer designed to connect management software, CRMs and custom XML feeds with WordPress.

The plugin is not limited to a specific industry or management system.

Quick Import provides predefined, ready-to-use integrations for supported management systems and WordPress destinations.

Manual Import allows XML data from different management systems to be mapped manually and imported into supported WordPress destinations. This makes PK InExPress suitable for custom integrations and different business sectors where structured XML data needs to be transferred into WordPress.

Current Quick Import integrations include:

  • RealSoftware → Houzez
  • RealSoftware → Estatik
  • MioGest → Houzez
  • MioGest → Estatik

Manual Import can be used with custom XML feeds from other management systems.

Supported Manual Import destinations include:

  • Houzez
  • Estatik
  • PK Products

PK Products works in a similar way to WordPress Posts: imported items are created as manageable content inside WordPress, with their own archive, images and structured information.

You can use PK Products without a specific theme or real estate plugin, making it a simple solution for importing XML content from different management systems and business sectors.

This allows PK InExPress to be used beyond real estate, depending on the structure of the XML feed and the selected destination.

The asynchronous import engine processes data in small batches to improve stability and reduce the risk of server timeouts.

Quick Import also includes recovery mechanisms for temporary server errors and connection interruptions.

The interface allows you to:

  • Import supported XML feeds using Quick Import.
  • Create custom XML mappings using Manual Import.
  • Process imports asynchronously in small batches.
  • Automatically create or update supported taxonomies, features, media and custom fields.
  • Update existing imported content without creating unnecessary duplicates.
  • Synchronize supported property data with Houzez and Estatik.
  • Import generic XML content into PK Products.
  • Recover more safely from temporary server or Internet connection problems during Quick Import.

PK InExPress Pro

PK InExPress Pro extends the Free version with automation and additional tools for recurring imports.

Pro features include:

  • Automatic scheduled imports using WP-Cron.
  • Multiple scheduled import jobs.
  • Automation of supported Quick Import integrations.
  • Automation of saved Manual Import mappings.
  • Optional image resizing during imports to reduce media size and help improve site performance.

The Free version remains fully usable for manual Quick Import and Manual Import operations.

PK InExPress does not send imported XML data to Punkode.

When importing from an XML URL, the plugin connects to the URL provided by the user to retrieve the XML feed and related media.

Import processing and WordPress content creation are performed on your WordPress site.

Disclaimer

PK InExPress imports XML data from external sources.

The plugin author is not responsible for the correctness, legality, or licensing of the imported XML.

Users must ensure they have the right to use such data according to applicable agreements and laws.

External services

PK InExPress does not require a Punkode external API to perform imports.

When the user configures an external XML URL, the plugin connects to that URL to retrieve the XML feed and, when applicable, related images or media.

The XML URL and imported data are provided and controlled by the user. Import data is not sent to Punkode.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the pk-inexpress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate PK InExPress from the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Open PK InExPress → Quick Import to use one of the predefined integrations.
  4. Select the source management system, destination and XML URL, then start the import.
  5. To import a custom XML structure, open PK InExPress → Manual Import, configure the mapping and run the import.
sections.faq:
What can I import with PK InExPress?

PK InExPress can import XML data from management software, CRMs and custom XML feeds.

Quick Import provides ready-to-use integrations for supported management systems and WordPress destinations.

Manual Import is generic and allows custom XML feeds from other management systems and different industries to be mapped and imported into supported WordPress destinations.

What are PK Products?

PK Products are a simple WordPress content type created by PK InExPress.

They work in a similar way to WordPress Posts: each imported item becomes a manageable content entry inside WordPress.

PK Products can include images, description, details, highlighted information and contact data, and can be displayed through their archive, navigation menus and sidebar widgets.

They are useful when you want to import XML data into WordPress without using a specific theme integration such as Houzez or Estatik.

Is PK InExPress only for real estate?

No.

The predefined Quick Import integrations currently focus on real estate management systems such as RealSoftware and MioGest, with Houzez and Estatik as supported destinations.

Manual Import is generic and can be used with custom XML feeds from other management systems and different industries.

Which Quick Import integrations are currently available?

  • RealSoftware → Houzez
  • RealSoftware → Estatik
  • MioGest → Houzez
  • MioGest → Estatik

Which Manual Import destinations are currently available?

Manual Import can import compatible custom XML feeds into:

  • Houzez
  • Estatik
  • PK Products

Can I use this with other WordPress themes or plugins?

PK InExPress currently includes dedicated integrations for Houzez and Estatik.

For generic WordPress use, Manual Import can import compatible XML feeds into PK Products without requiring a specific real estate theme.

More destinations may be added in future releases.

Can I import XML from another management system?

Yes.

Manual Import allows custom XML fields to be mapped to supported WordPress destinations.

The XML feed does not need to come from RealSoftware or MioGest.

Does it support cron jobs (automatic scheduled imports)?

Yes. PK InExPress Pro supports automatic scheduled imports using WP-Cron.

The Pro version can automate supported Quick Import integrations and saved Manual Import mappings.

It also includes optional image resizing to reduce the size of imported media and help improve site performance.
sections.changelog:
1.2.5

  • Maintenance: Improved plugin metadata and version consistency.
  • Maintenance: Improved compatibility between Free and Pro components.
  • Maintenance: Updated translation strings and language files.
  • Maintenance: Minor code cleanup and internal consistency improvements.

1.2.4

  • Added PK Products as a Manual Import destination for generic WordPress content.
  • Added structured PK Products sections: Details, Highlights, Information and Contacts.
  • Added conditional section titles that are shown only when related mapped data is available.
  • Added a dedicated Description section for PK Products.
  • Added full frontend gallery support for imported PK Products images.
  • Added image slider navigation for PK Products galleries.
  • Added PK Products archive support and improved navigation menu integration.
  • Added a PK Products sidebar widget with configurable title, item count, image display and price display.
  • Improved visual presentation of imported PK Products with neutral, theme-friendly styling.
  • Improved handling of reusable imported media to avoid unnecessary image re-downloads.
  • Improved Manual Import flexibility for custom XML feeds and generic WordPress content.

1.2.3

  • Security: Improved validation of remote XML and media URLs to prevent unsafe internal requests (SSRF).
  • Maintenance: Improved WordPress coding standards compliance and Plugin Check compatibility.
  • Maintenance: Cleaned up the production package and readme metadata.

1.2.2

  • Improved Quick Import stability and reliability.
  • Reduced Quick Import batch size to minimize server timeouts during heavy imports.
  • Added safer delays between asynchronous import requests.
  • Improved handling of temporary server errors and 504 Gateway Timeout responses.
  • Added automatic retry with progressive delays when temporary errors occur.
  • Added automatic pause when the browser loses its Internet connection.
  • Quick Import now automatically resumes when the Internet connection is restored.
  • Improved protection against stalled import batches.
  • Improved Quick Import progress interface.

1.2.1

  • Fixed latitude and longitude handling for property imports and updates.
  • Improved coordinate normalization to correctly support decimal values using commas or dots.
  • Resolved an issue that could cause latitude and longitude values to be truncated, resulting in incorrect map positions.
  • This fix also improves compatibility with properties imported using previous versions of InExPress.

1.2.0

  • Added Estatik as a Manual Import destination.
  • Added verified Estatik mapping fields for property data, location, taxonomies, video and images.
  • Added generic Estatik manual importer and runner with saved mapping support.
  • Added asynchronous Manual Import support for Estatik.
  • Added Quick Import support for RealSoftware → Estatik.
  • Added Quick Import support for MioGest → Estatik.

1.1.11

  • Added the missing modules directory to the WordPress.org package.
  • Removed the need to manually enter the word “Codice” in the configuration field.
  • The “Codice” prefix is now handled automatically by InExPress.

1.1.10

  • New: Added Property Slideshow module.
  • New: Fullscreen slideshow page optimized for TVs and office displays.
  • New: Dedicated Slideshow administration page.
  • New: Public slideshow URL with quick open and copy actions.
  • Improved: Responsive slideshow layout and property information display.
  • Improved: Better compatibility with different screen sizes.

1.1.9

  • Added Property Slideshow support.

1.1.8

  • Fixed MioGest property type.

1.1.7

  • Fixed MioGest contract type mapping. Property status is now correctly set.

1.1.6

  • Updated Freemius integration.

1.1.5

  • Improved translations.

1.1.4

  • New: Added manual AJAX import (Quick Import) with step-based processing.
  • New: Real-time progress display in the admin interface (processed / total).
  • New: Import and update now run in safe micro-batches to prevent server timeouts.
  • Improved stability when handling large XML files and heavy image sets.
  • Improved error reporting during asynchronous import.

1.1.2

  • Improved RealSoftware agent matching when names contain accents.

1.1.1

  • Added support for MioGest to Houzez integration.

1.0.1

  • Added Freemius integration.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Supports import from RealSoftware to Houzez.
